    ],
}

# Python transformation script displayed in the code viewer
sample_transformation_code = '''import json
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEntity(BaseModel):
    document_id: str
    filing_entity: str
    total_revenue_usd: float = Field(..., description="Audited GAAP revenue")
    operating_income_usd: float
    net_retention_rate: float
    verification_hash: str

def parse_and_validate(raw_payload: dict) -> FinancialEntity:
    """Normalize extracted OCR bounding boxes into verified entity records."""
    metrics = raw_payload.get("financial_metrics", {})
    return FinancialEntity(
        document_id=raw_payload["document_id"],
        filing_entity=raw_payload["filing_entity"],
        total_revenue_usd=metrics["total_revenue_usd"],
        operating_income_usd=metrics["operating_income_usd"],
        net_retention_rate=metrics["net_retention_rate"],
        verification_hash="sha256:7f83b1657ff1fc53b92dc18148a1d65dfc2d4b1fa3d677284addd200126d9069"
    )
'''

def handle_ocr_engine_change(value: str):

        title="2FA Security Token",
    )


def handle_masking_toggle(checked: bool):
    """Triggered when user toggles zero-knowledge PII masking."""

            # Audit Action Buttons Footer
            with ui.row(class_name="flex-row items-center gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-border/80"):
                ui.button("Download Signed Compliance Certificate", on_click=handle_download_cert, variant="default", class_name="text-xs font-semibold h-8 shadow-xs")
                ui.button("Purge Transient Cache", on_click=handle_purge_cache, variant="destructive", class_name="text-xs font-semibold h-8")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Standalone Server Execution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Launch on port 8084 for standalone or test execution
    app.launch(port=8084)

"""Example 05: Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarm & Execution DAG Studio.

A mission-critical multi-agent coordination and execution DAG workspace featuring:
- Full-screen or header-enabled mode (header=True by default, can be set to False)
- Persistent swarm topology navigation sidebar with pinned AI Systems Architect profile
- Interactive breadcrumb navigation (ui.breadcrumb) and contextual tooltips (ui.tooltip)
- Top header action bar featuring slide-over trace sheets (ui.sheet) and deployment dialogs (ui.dialog)
- 4 executive KPI metric cards for worker count, swarm token economics, latency, and judge score
- Visual execution DAG representation showing supervisor and specialist agent node states
- Semantic intent router rules table and LLM-as-a-Judge quantitative evaluation scorecard
- Reactive Python callbacks (on_click) displaying live ui.toast() alert notifications
- Red / Crimson executive terminal palette (palette="red")
"""

from typing import Any
import pyvello as ui
from pyvello.graph.models import NodeKind, NodeStatus

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Dataset & Swarm Topology Definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Semantic Router Intent Classification Rules
router_rules = [
    {
        "intent": "Database Schema & Migration",
        "target_agent": "Database Architect",
        "model": "gpt-4o",
        "confidence": "99.4%",
        "sample": "Add foreign key indexing and partitioned audit log tables",
    },
    {
        "intent": "Core Backend Code Synthesis",
        "target_agent": "Code Synthesizer",
        "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet",
        "confidence": "98.8%",
        "sample": "Refactor async connection pool with exponential backoff",
    },
    {
        "intent": "Vulnerability & Security Audit",
        "target_agent": "Security Auditor",
        "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
        "confidence": "99.1%",
        "sample": "Scan AST for unsanitized raw SQL and timing attacks",
    },
    {
        "intent": "Automated Quality & Verification",
        "target_agent": "LLM Evaluator",
        "model": "deepseek-r1",
        "confidence": "97.6%",
        "sample": "Grade correctness against RFC 7231 and generate pytest suite",
    },
]

# LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Scorecard Metrics
judge_scorecard = [
    {
        "criteria": "Functional Correctness",
        "weight": "35%",
        "score": "99.2%",
        "status": "Passed",
        "evaluator": "deepseek-r1",
    },
    {
        "criteria": "Security & Zero PII Leakage",
        "weight": "30%",
        "score": "99.8%",
        "status": "Passed",
        "evaluator": "gpt-4o",
    },
    {
        "criteria": "Test Coverage & Edge Cases",
        "weight": "20%",
        "score": "94.6%",
        "status": "Passed",
        "evaluator": "claude-3-5-sonnet",
    },
    {
        "criteria": "Code Complexity & Cyclomatic Depth",
        "weight": "15%",
        "score": "96.1%",
        "status": "Passed",
        "evaluator": "gpt-4o-mini",
    },
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reactive Event Handlers (User Actions & Alert Callbacks)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_nav_dag():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'DAG Topology' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Viewing Live Multi-Agent Execution DAG Graph and Node Topology.",
        type="info",
        title="DAG Topology",
    )


def handle_nav_workers():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Worker Agents' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Viewing 4 active specialized worker agents and prompt contexts.",
        type="info",
        title="Worker Agents",
    )


def handle_nav_router():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Router Rules' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Opened Semantic Intent Router classification matrix.",
        type="info",
        title="Router Rules",
    )


def handle_nav_judge():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Judge Scorecards' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Loaded automated LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation benchmarks.",
        type="info",
        title="Judge Scorecards",
    )


def handle_nav_settings():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Cluster Settings' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Opened Swarm Concurrency, Token Budget, and Rate-Limiting dialog.",
        type="info",
        title="Cluster Settings",
    )


def handle_trigger_swarm():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Trigger Swarm' in the header."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Swarm execution initiated: Architecture Planner node active.",
        type="success",
        title="Swarm Started",
    )


def handle_pause_swarm():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Pause Execution'."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Swarm execution suspended. Active agent workers idling safely.",
        type="warning",
        title="Swarm Paused",
    )


def handle_export_dag():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Export DAG Trace'."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Exported OpenTelemetry execution trace and token breakdown (JSON).",
        type="success",
        title="DAG Trace Exported",
    )


def handle_confirm_deploy():
    """Triggered when user confirms deployment inside the dialog."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Deployed multi-agent swarm to us-east-1 production Kubernetes pods.",
        type="success",
        title="Deployment Complete",
    )


def handle_view_architect():
    """Triggered when user clicks the architect profile footer."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Architect: Dr. Aris Thorne | Role: Lead AI Systems Architect | Clearance: Swarm Supervisor",
        type="info",
        title="AI Architect Profile",
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Reactive UI Layout Architecture
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# with ui.App() creates the single-page application container.
# palette="red" applies the high-visibility crimson / incident red color scheme.
# header=True is the default. Pass header=False to completely hide the top navbar
# for full-screen kiosk displays or embedded NOC monitoring walls:
# with ui.App(title="...", theme="light", palette="red", header=False) as app:
with ui.App(
    title="Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarm & Execution DAG Studio",
    theme="light",
    palette="red",
    header=True,
) as app:

    # Populate application execution graph nodes and edges
    if app.graph:
        n1 = app.graph.add_node("planner", label="Architecture Planner", kind=NodeKind.AGENT, model="gpt-4o")
        n1.status = NodeStatus.COMPLETED
        n2 = app.graph.add_node("coder", label="Code Synthesizer", kind=NodeKind.AGENT, model="claude-3-5-sonnet")
        n2.status = NodeStatus.RUNNING
        n3 = app.graph.add_node("auditor", label="Security Auditor", kind=NodeKind.AGENT, model="gpt-4o-mini")
        n3.status = NodeStatus.IDLE
        n4 = app.graph.add_node("judge", label="LLM Evaluator", kind=NodeKind.LLM, model="deepseek-r1")
        n4.status = NodeStatus.IDLE
        app.graph.add_edge("planner", "coder", animated=True)
        app.graph.add_edge("coder", "auditor")
        app.graph.add_edge("auditor", "judge")

    # 3A. Persistent Navigation & Dimensions Sidebar
    with ui.sidebar():
        # Command Center Brand Header
        with ui.row(class_name="items-center justify-between w-full pb-1"):
            with ui.row(class_name="items-center gap-2 min-w-0"):

        # Primary Navigation Menu with Interactive Handlers

        ui.button(
            "DAG Topology",

"""Example 06: Multimodal Generative Media & Automated Function Workbench.

An executive-grade multimodal media studio and function runner featuring:
- Full-screen or header-enabled mode (header=True by default, can be set to False)
- Automatic web UI form generation from Python function signatures (ui.from_function / AutoForm)
- Multimodal media rendering: high-resolution image (ui.image), audio player (ui.audio), and video stream (ui.video)
- Granular freeform inputs: multi-line negative prompt (ui.text_area), numeric LoRA stepper (ui.number_input), and model endpoint (ui.text_input)
- Animated loading skeleton placeholders (ui.skeleton)
- Persistent creative studio navigation sidebar with pinned Creative Director profile
- Reactive Python callbacks (on_click, on_change) with live ui.toast() alert notifications
- Gold / Amber executive terminal palette (palette="yellow")
"""

from typing import Any, Dict
import pyvello as ui

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Target Python Function for Automated Form Ingestion (ui.from_function)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_synthetic_media(
    prompt: str = "Cyberpunk neon city skyline reflected in rainfall, volumetric golden lighting",
    style_preset: str = "Cinematic Hyper-Realism",
    guidance_scale: float = 7.5,
    num_inference_steps: int = 30,
    aspect_ratio: str = "16:9",
    seed: int = 42,
    enable_hd_upscaling: bool = True,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute text-to-image and multimodal media synthesis with customizable sampling parameters.

    Args:
        prompt: Detailed creative prompt describing the visual scene and lighting.
        style_preset: Visual aesthetic preset applied to the latent space.
        guidance_scale: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale balancing creativity vs prompt fidelity.
        num_inference_steps: Denoising steps executed by the diffusion scheduler.
        aspect_ratio: Output canvas aspect ratio (e.g., 16:9 widescreen or 1:1 square).
        seed: Random seed for deterministic reproducibility.
        enable_hd_upscaling: Apply secondary 4k latent upscaler model.
    """
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "asset_id": "ASSET-GEN-9421",
        "prompt": prompt,
        "style_preset": style_preset,
        "guidance_scale": guidance_scale,
        "num_inference_steps": num_inference_steps,
        "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
        "seed": seed,
        "hd_upscaling": enable_hd_upscaling,
        "resolution": "3840x2160 (4K UHD)",
        "inference_time_ms": 1420.5,
        "engine": "Pyvello Diffusion & Docker Sandbox",
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reactive Event Handlers (User Actions & Alert Callbacks)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_nav_workbench():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Function Workbench' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Viewing Automated Function Workbench & Diffusion Parameters.",
        type="info",
        title="Function Workbench",
    )


def handle_nav_gallery():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Media Gallery' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Loaded 1,420 generated 4k images, audio narrations, and video clips.",
        type="info",
        title="Media Gallery",
    )


def handle_nav_models():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Model Checkpoints' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Viewing HuggingFace, Replicate, and local ComfyUI model registry.",
        type="info",
        title="Model Registry",
    )


def handle_nav_docker():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Docker Sandbox' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Connected to isolated Docker container with CUDA GPU acceleration.",
        type="info",
        title="Docker Sandbox",
    )


def handle_nav_settings():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Studio Settings' in the sidebar."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Opened GPU VRAM caching, batch queue, and storage retention settings.",
        type="info",
        title="Studio Settings",
    )


def handle_generate_media():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Run Multimodal Synthesis' in the header."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Synthesis complete: 4k image canvas, voiceover narration, and video clip generated.",
        type="success",
        title="Synthesis Complete",
    )


def handle_download_bundle():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Download Media Bundle'."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Downloaded creative media bundle (PNG image, MP3 voiceover, MP4 video).",
        type="success",
        title="Bundle Downloaded",
    )


def handle_clear_scratch():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Clear Scratch Buffer'."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Cleared latent scratch canvas and intermediate noise tensors.",
        type="info",
        title="Buffer Cleared",
    )


def handle_export_script():
    """Triggered when user clicks 'Export PyTorch Script'."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Exported standalone diffusers Python script for offline GPU inference.",
        type="success",
        title="Script Exported",
    )


def handle_view_director():
    """Triggered when user clicks the creative director profile footer."""
    ui.toast(
        message="Director: Chloe Bennett | Role: Principal Generative Media Architect | Clearance: Multimodal Lead",
        type="info",
        title="Creative Director Profile",
    )


def handle_negative_change(val: str):
    """Triggered when user types in the negative prompt textarea."""
    ui.toast(
        message=f"Negative prompt guidance updated: '{val[:25]}...'",
        type="info",
        title="Negative Prompt Updated",
    )


def handle_lora_change(val: float):
    """Triggered when user changes the LoRA numeric input."""
    ui.toast(
        message=f"LoRA fine-tuning weight calibrated to {val:.2f}.",
        type="warning",
        title="LoRA Calibrated",
    )


def handle_checkpoint_change(val: str):
    """Triggered when user changes model checkpoint text input."""
    ui.toast(
        message=f"Active diffusion model checkpoint updated to '{val}'.",
        type="info",
        title="Checkpoint Loaded",
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Reactive UI Layout Architecture
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# palette="yellow" sets the gold / amber executive terminal color scheme.
# header=True is the default. Pass header=False to completely hide the top navbar
# for full-screen kiosk displays or embedded creative video walls:
# with ui.App(title="...", theme="light", palette="yellow", header=False) as app:
with ui.App(
    title="Multimodal Generative Media & Automated Function Workbench",
    theme="light",
    palette="yellow",
    header=True,
) as app:

    # 3A. Persistent Navigation & Dimensions Sidebar
    with ui.sidebar():
        # Studio Brand Header
        with ui.row(class_name="items-center justify-between w-full pb-1"):
            with ui.row(class_name="items-center gap-2 min-w-0"):
                ui.badge(
                    "AI",
                    variant="default",
                    class_name="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs p-0 shrink-0",
                )
                with ui.column(class_name="min-w-0 gap-0"):
                    ui.text("Acme Media AI", class_name="font-bold text-xs text-foreground tracking-tight truncate leading-tight")
                    ui.text("Generative Workbench", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate leading-tight")
            ui.badge("v6.0", variant="secondary", class_name="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 shrink-0")

        ui.separator()

        # Primary Navigation Menu with Interactive Handlers
        ui.text("Creative Views", class_name="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold")
        ui.button(
            "Function Workbench",
            icon="sliders-horizontal",
            on_click=handle_nav_workbench,
            variant="default",
            class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-semibold h-8 shadow-xs",
        )
        ui.button(
            "Media Gallery",
            icon="image",
            on_click=handle_nav_gallery,
            variant="ghost",
            class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
        )
        ui.button(
            "Model Checkpoints",
            icon="box",
            on_click=handle_nav_models,
            variant="ghost",
            class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
        )
        ui.button(
            "Docker Sandbox",
            icon="container",
            on_click=handle_nav_docker,
            variant="ghost",
            class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
        )
        ui.button(
            "Studio Settings",
            icon="settings",
            on_click=handle_nav_settings,
            variant="ghost",
            class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
        )

        ui.separator()

        # Operational Pipeline Dimensions
        ui.text("Inference Engine", class_name="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold")
        with ui.row(class_name="w-full justify-between items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground"):
            ui.text("Engine Mode", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground")
            ui.text("AutoForm Inferred", class_name="font-semibold text-foreground text-[10px]")

        with ui.row(class_name="w-full justify-between items-center px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground"):
            ui.text("GPU Cluster", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground")
            ui.text("4x H100 (Online)", class_name="font-semibold text-emerald-500 text-[10px]")

        # Pinned Creative Director Profile Footer (Sticks to bottom, interactive)
        with ui.row(class_name="pt-3 border-t border-border/80 items-center justify-between w-full mt-auto select-none"):
            with ui.row(class_name="items-center gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1"):
                ui.avatar(fallback="CB", class_name="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary/20 text-primary border border-primary/30 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center")
                with ui.column(class_name="min-w-0 flex-1 gap-0"):
                    ui.text("Chloe Bennett", class_name="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground truncate leading-tight")
                    ui.text("Creative Director", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate leading-tight")
            ui.button(
                "Profile",
                on_click=handle_view_director,
                variant="ghost",
                class_name="text-[10px] font-mono h-6 px-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
            )

    # 3B. Main Content Viewport
    # Header Title & Action Controls
    with ui.row(class_name="flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between w-full pb-2 border-b border-border/60 gap-3 select-none"):
        with ui.column(class_name="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5"):
            ui.title(
                "Multimodal Generative Media & Automated Function Workbench",
                level=4,
                class_name="text-sm font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight",
            )
            ui.text(
                "Automated Python function UI inference (AutoForm) combined with synthetic image, audio, and video preview.",
                class_name="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground",
            )
        with ui.row(class_name="flex-row items-center gap-2 w-auto shrink-0 flex-wrap"):
            ui.button(
                "Run Synthesis",
                icon="sparkles",

            ui.button(

    # Advisory Status Callout
    ui.callout(
        "AutoForm automatically parsed generate_synthetic_media() type annotations and generated interactive sliders, switches, and JSON response viewers.",

        class_name="text-xs font-medium my-2",

    # Two-Column Creative Studio Container
    with ui.row(class_name="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 w-full my-2"):
        # Left Column: Automated Function Form Inferred from Python (ui.from_function / AutoForm)
        with ui.column(class_name="space-y-4"):
            ui.title("Automated Function Ingestion (Streamlit / Gradio Parity)", level=4, class_name="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-mono")
            
            # The AutoForm component generated directly from Python function
            ui.from_function(
                generate_synthetic_media,
                title="Generative Diffusion Inference Runner",
                description="Automatically inferred from Python function signature with type annotations.",

            )

            # Additional Freeform Inputs (Textarea, NumberInput, TextInput)
            with ui.column(class_name="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/60 space-y-3"):
                ui.title("Advanced Latent Space Controls", level=4, class_name="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-mono")
                
                ui.text_area(

                with ui.row(class_name="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 w-full"):

        # Right Column: Multimodal Media Outputs (Image, Audio, Video, Skeletons)
        with ui.column(class_name="space-y-4"):

            # Synthetic Image Canvas (ui.image)

                ui.text("Generated 4K Visual Canvas", class_name="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground")
                ui.image(
                    src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1618005182384-a83a8bd57fbe?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80",
                    caption="Diffusion Render: Cyberpunk neon city in rainfall (Seed: 42, Steps: 30, CFG: 7.5)",
                    alt="Synthetic Cyberpunk Neon Architecture",
                    class_name="rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-border/80 shadow-md",
                )

            # Audio Voiceover Player (ui.audio)
            with ui.column(class_name="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/60 space-y-2"):
                ui.text("Synthesized Multimodal Voiceover Narration", class_name="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground")
                ui.audio(
                    src="https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3",
                    caption="Voiceover: English (US) - Neural High-Fidelity Speech Model",
                    class_name="w-full",
                )

            # Video Clip Player (ui.video)
            with ui.column(class_name="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/60 space-y-2"):
                ui.text("Synthesized Animation Clip (H.264 / 60fps)", class_name="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground")
                ui.video(
                    src="https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/ForBiggerBlazes.mp4",
                    caption="Motion Diffusion: Volumetric rain lighting sequence (16:9 widescreen)",
                    class_name="w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm",
                )

            # Loading State Skeleton Placeholder (ui.skeleton)
            with ui.column(class_name="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border bg-muted/20 space-y-2"):
                ui.text("Background Secondary Upscaling Queue (Idle)", class_name="text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground")
                ui.skeleton(width="100%", height="14px")
                ui.skeleton(width="60%", height="14px")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Standalone Server Execution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Launch on port 8086 for standalone or test execution
    app.launch(port=8086)

07. Secure Enterprise Portal & Zero-Trust Auth

Production-grade enterprise portal demonstrating built-in authentication, user registration, role policies, and session persistence in Pyvello. Supports both single-user gated tools and high-concurrency multi-user team workspaces with zero external dependencies.

Turnkey Auth Experience

Unauthenticated visitors see a centered, shadcn-styled card with 'Sign In' and 'Create Account' tabs. The application unlocks immediately upon verification.

Single & Multi-User Modes

Toggle registration via allow_registration=False for private single-user tools, or keep it enabled for open multi-user SaaS.

Live User Identity in Callbacks

Python event handlers inspect active session claims via ui.current_user() to trigger user-aware alert notifications.

"""Pyvello Example 07: Authenticated Enterprise Portal.

Demonstrates built-in authentication, user registration, role policies,
and session persistence in Pyvello. Supports both single-user and multi-user modes.
"""

import pyvello as ui

def handle_refresh_telemetry():
    user = ui.current_user()
    username = user.username if user else "Anonymous"
    ui.toast(
        message=f"Telemetry cache invalidated and refreshed by [{username}].",
        title="Telemetry Synchronized",
        type="info",
    )

def handle_security_audit():
    user = ui.current_user()
    username = user.username if user else "Anonymous"
    ui.toast(
        message=f"Security audit initiated by [{username}]. All cryptographic signatures verified.",
        title="Security Audit Passed",
        type="success",
    )

def handle_generate_api_key():
    user = ui.current_user()
    username = user.username if user else "Anonymous"
    ui.toast(
        message=f"New scoped API token generated for [{username}]. Token copied to clipboard.",
        title="API Key Issued",
        type="success",
    )

def handle_purge_cache():
    user = ui.current_user()
    username = user.username if user else "Anonymous"
    ui.toast(
        message=f"Ephemeral operational cache cleared by [{username}].",
        title="Cache Evicted",
        type="warning",
    )

def handle_view_profile():
    user = ui.current_user()
    if user:
        email_str = f" | Email: {user.email}" if user.email else ""
        ui.toast(
            message=f"User ID: {user.id} | Username: {user.username}{email_str} | Role: {user.role}",
            title="User Profile",
            type="info",
        )

with ui.App(
    title="Secure Enterprise Portal",
    auth=ui.Auth(
        allow_registration=True,      # Multi-user mode: signups enabled
        storage="sqlite",              # Persistent user and session database
        db_path="portal_users.db",
        default_users={"admin": "admin123"},
    ),
    theme="light",
    palette="indigo",
) as app:

    with ui.sidebar():
        with ui.row(class_name="items-center justify-between w-full pb-1"):
            with ui.row(class_name="items-center gap-2 min-w-0"):
                ui.badge("EP", variant="default", class_name="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs p-0 shrink-0")
                with ui.column(class_name="min-w-0 gap-0"):
                    ui.text("Enterprise Portal", class_name="font-bold text-xs text-foreground tracking-tight truncate leading-tight")
                    ui.text("Zero-Trust Security", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate leading-tight")
            ui.badge("v1.0", variant="secondary", class_name="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 shrink-0")

        ui.separator()

        ui.text("Main Menu", class_name="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold")
        ui.button("Security Overview", icon="shield", on_click=handle_refresh_telemetry, variant="default", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-semibold h-8 shadow-xs")
        ui.button("Access Governance", icon="key", on_click=handle_generate_api_key, variant="ghost", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")
        ui.button("Cryptographic Audit", icon="shield-check", on_click=handle_security_audit, variant="ghost", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")

        ui.separator()

        ui.text("Operations", class_name="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold")
        ui.button("Refresh Telemetry", icon="refresh-cw", on_click=handle_refresh_telemetry, variant="outline", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8")
        ui.button("Purge Cache", icon="trash-2", on_click=handle_purge_cache, variant="outline", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8")

        with ui.column(class_name="mt-auto pt-3 border-t border-border/60 gap-1.5"):
            ui.button("Inspect Session Claims", icon="user", on_click=handle_view_profile, variant="ghost", class_name="w-full justify-start text-xs font-medium h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")
            ui.text("Protocol: TLS 1.3 / WSS Authenticated", class_name="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center")

    ui.title("Security & Operations Overview", level=2, subtitle="Real-time operational dashboard monitoring authenticated sessions and cryptographic status.")

    with ui.row():
        ui.metric("Active Sessions", "48", delta="+12 today", delta_type="positive")
        ui.metric("Auth Policy Health", "99.8%", delta="+0.4%", delta_type="positive")
        ui.metric("Failed Logins", "0", delta="-3 past 24h", delta_type="positive")
        ui.metric("Storage Volume", "14.2 GB", delta="+250 MB", delta_type="neutral")

    with ui.row():
        with ui.card(title="Current Session Profile", description="Identity claims and verified session metadata"):
            ui.text("Your session token is cryptographically verified via SQLite persistence. The username is visible in the top header bar alongside a one-click Sign Out action.", class_name="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-relaxed")
            with ui.row():
                ui.badge("Session: ACTIVE", variant="outline")
                ui.badge("Storage: SQLite", variant="secondary")
                ui.badge("PBKDF2-HMAC: SHA-256", variant="default")
            ui.separator()
            ui.text("Default administrative credentials seeded on first launch: username 'admin', password 'admin123'. New accounts can be registered seamlessly via the 'Create Account' tab.", class_name="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed")
            ui.button("Run Security Audit", variant="default", size="sm", icon="shield-check", on_click=handle_security_audit, class_name="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold")

        with ui.card(title="Platform Health & Cryptography", description="Automated audit compliance across system services"):
            ui.text("All password hashes utilize PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100,000 iterations and per-user 32-character hex salts.", class_name="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3 leading-relaxed")
            with ui.row():
                ui.metric("Hash Rounds", "100,000", delta="PBKDF2-HMAC")
                ui.metric("Token Entropy", "256-bit", delta="URL-safe")
            ui.button("Purge Ephemeral Cache", variant="outline", size="sm", icon="trash-2", on_click=handle_purge_cache, class_name="mt-3 text-xs font-medium")

    with ui.card(title="Authentication Audit Log", description="Recent access attempts and token validation events"):
        audit_events = [
            {"timestamp": "2026-10-28 08:14:02", "actor": "admin", "event": "SESSION_INITIALIZE", "status": "SUCCESS", "ip": "127.0.0.1"},
            {"timestamp": "2026-10-28 08:12:45", "actor": "system", "event": "DB_SCHEMA_MIGRATION", "status": "SUCCESS", "ip": "localhost"},
            {"timestamp": "2026-10-28 08:10:19", "actor": "security_bot", "event": "SIGNATURE_VERIFY", "status": "SUCCESS", "ip": "10.0.4.12"},
            {"timestamp": "2026-10-28 08:05:00", "actor": "admin", "event": "TOKEN_REFRESH", "status": "SUCCESS", "ip": "127.0.0.1"},
        ]
        ui.table(data=audit_events, columns=["timestamp", "actor", "event", "status", "ip"], page_size=5, searchable=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch(port=8087)

08. Direct OpenAI & Google SDK Integration (Sessions & Messages History)

Wire official vendor Python SDKs directly into Pyvello without abstraction overhead. Direct OpenAI SDK

Declare def chat(messages): and pass the full array directly to client.chat.completions.create(messages=messages, stream=True).

Google GenAI SDK

Convert unified message roles (user/assistant) into Gemini contents parts and stream via client.models.generate_content_stream().

Multi-Session Isolation

Each session tab in ui.chat() maintains independent conversation history. Pyvello injects session_id for custom server stores.

Architecture Unified History Injection & Session Isolation

When you define a chat callback with parameters (messages, model, session_id), Pyvello automatically injects the active session tab's complete conversation array in standard OpenAI schema. Simply pass it directly to client.chat.completions.create(messages=messages, stream=True) and yield tokens as they arrive.

ChatAssistant LLM called 1
doc_examples/08_native_llm_sdk_sessions.py ×
python 
import os
import time
import asyncio
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict, List, Optional
import pyvello as ui

# 1. Vendor SDK Imports
try:
    from openai import AsyncOpenAI
    HAS_OPENAI_SDK = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_OPENAI_SDK = False

try:
    from google import genai
    HAS_GOOGLE_GENAI_SDK = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_GOOGLE_GENAI_SDK = False

# Server-side registry for custom session analytics
SESSION_REGISTRY: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

# 2. Direct OpenAI SDK Streaming Handler
async def stream_openai_sdk(messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], model_name: str, session_id: Optional[str]) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if HAS_OPENAI_SDK and api_key and not api_key.startswith("mock-"):
        client = AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key)
        stream = await client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model_name,
            messages=[{"role": m.get("role", "user"), "content": str(m.get("content", ""))} for m in messages],
            stream=True,
            temperature=0.7,
        )
        async for chunk in stream:
            delta = chunk.choices[0].delta.content or ""
            if delta:
                yield delta
    else:
        # Simulated fallback preserving exact OpenAI messages payload
        prompt = messages[-1].get("content", "") if messages else ""
        yield f"[OpenAI SDK Stream | Model: {model_name} | Session: {session_id}]\n\n"
        yield f"Received {len(messages)} historical turns in OpenAI messages format.\n\n"
        yield f"Echoing prompt: {prompt}"

# 3. Direct Google GenAI SDK Streaming Handler
async def stream_google_sdk(messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], model_name: str, session_id: Optional[str]) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    api_key = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
    if HAS_GOOGLE_GENAI_SDK and api_key and not api_key.startswith("mock-"):
        client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
        # Convert unified messages to Gemini contents schema
        gemini_contents = [
            {"role": "user" if m.get("role") == "user" else "model", "parts": [{"text": str(m.get("content", ""))}]}
            for m in messages
        ]
        response_stream = client.models.generate_content_stream(model=model_name, contents=gemini_contents)
        for chunk in response_stream:
            if getattr(chunk, "text", ""):
                yield chunk.text
    else:
        prompt = messages[-1].get("content", "") if messages else ""
        yield f"[Google GenAI SDK Stream | Model: {model_name} | Session: {session_id}]\n\n"
        yield f"Converted {len(messages)} turns to Google Gemini contents schema.\n\n"
        yield f"Echoing prompt: {prompt}"

# 4. Master Unified Chat Handler (Auto-Injected by Pyvello)
async def unified_sdk_chat_handler(
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    model: str = "OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini)",
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    """Pyvello automatically injects messages, model, and session_id."""
    active_sid = session_id or "default"
    if active_sid not in SESSION_REGISTRY:
        SESSION_REGISTRY[active_sid] = {"turns": 0, "last_model": model}
    SESSION_REGISTRY[active_sid]["turns"] += 1
    SESSION_REGISTRY[active_sid]["message_count"] = len(messages)

    if "Google" in model or "gemini" in model.lower():
        gemini_model = "gemini-2.0-flash" if "2.0" in model else "gemini-1.5-pro"
        async for chunk in stream_google_sdk(messages, model_name=gemini_model, session_id=session_id):
            yield chunk
    else:
        openai_model = "gpt-4o" if "gpt-4o" in model and "mini" not in model else "gpt-4o-mini"
        async for chunk in stream_openai_sdk(messages, model_name=openai_model, session_id=session_id):
            yield chunk

# 5. Build Workspace Layout
with ui.App(title="Native LLM SDK Integration & Session Architecture", theme="light", palette="violet") as app:
    with ui.sidebar():
        ui.text("Pyvello SDK Studio", class_name="font-bold text-xs")
        ui.separator()
        ui.text("Supported SDK Providers", class_name="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase font-semibold")
        ui.badge("AsyncOpenAI", variant="outline")
        ui.badge("google.genai", variant="outline")

    ui.title("Direct OpenAI & Google SDK Integration", level=4)
    ui.text("Wire native Python SDK clients directly into Pyvello. Learn how conversation history, session tabs, and token streaming work.")

    # Reactive Chat Interface with Multi-Session & Vendor Dropdown
    ui.chat(
        on_send=unified_sdk_chat_handler,
        models=[
            "OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini)",
            "Google (gemini-2.0-flash)",
            "OpenAI (gpt-4o)",
            "Google (gemini-1.5-pro)",
        ],
        placeholder="Type a message or select a test case from the sidebar...",
        id="native_sdk_chat",
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch(port=8089)

import os
import pyvello as ui

# Single unified omni-agent with native multimodal capabilities (just like ChatGPT)
# Works across any model provider: OpenRouter, OpenAI, or custom/Chinese endpoints
assistant = ui.Agent(
    name="UniversalMultimodalStudio",
    # Primary reasoning model (OpenRouter GLM 5.3 Flash / GPT-4o)
    model=os.environ.get("PYVELLO_DEFAULT_MODEL", "openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"),

    # 1. Native Image Generation: FLUX, Seedream, Ideogram, Fal, or DALL-E
    # E.g. image="bfl/flux-pro-1.1", "fal/flux/schnell", or "openrouter/bytedance-seed/seedream-5-0-flash"
    image="openrouter/bytedance-seed/seedream-5-0-flash",

    # E.g. video="kling/kling-v1", "runway/gen3a_turbo", or "openrouter/bytedance/seedance-2.0-mini"
    video="openrouter/bytedance/seedance-2.0-mini",

    # 3. Native Audio & Voice Synthesis: ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, or HeyGen
    # E.g. audio="elevenlabs/multilingual_v2", "cartesia/sonic-english", or "openrouter/heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo"
    audio="openrouter/heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo",
    audio_voice="alloy",

    # 4. Native Executive Document & PDF Generation
    pdf=True,

    system_prompt=(

        "and natively generate images, videos, audio narration, and executive PDF documents on demand."
    ),
)

# Launch unified studio app with one command

    title="Universal Multimodal Studio",
    description="Single-chat multi-model AI assistant with native image, video, audio, and PDF generation.",
    placeholder="Ask for an image, video, audio narration, PDF report, or reasoning query...",

if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo.launch(port=8005)

Custom Function Calling

Authoring Custom Agent Tools (@ui.tool)

In addition to the 135+ built-in enterprise connectors, any standard Python function or async coroutine can be converted into an LLM-callable tool using the @ui.tool decorator. Pyvello automatically parses your function's docstring and type annotations into strict JSON schemas compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.

1. Docstring Parsing

The function's docstring provides the semantic tool description the LLM reads to determine when to call the tool.

2. Type Hint Validation

Primitive types (str, int, float, bool) and Pydantic models automatically enforce parameter extraction.

3. Native Async / Sync

Supports both synchronous functions and non-blocking async def coroutines for database queries and external HTTP APIs.

custom_tools.py 
import pyvello as ui
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Dict, Any

class TransferRequest(BaseModel):
    recipient_iban: str = Field(description="Target account IBAN string")
    amount_usd: float = Field(gt=0, description="Transfer amount in USD")
    reference_note: str = Field(default="Automated settlement", description="Audit note")

# 1. Simple Typed Function Tool
@ui.tool
def get_account_balance(account_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Retrieve real-time ledger balance and status for an account."""
    return {"account_id": account_id, "balance_usd": 142500.50, "status": "active"}

# 2. Advanced Validated Tool with Pydantic Schema
@ui.tool
async def execute_funds_transfer(transfer: TransferRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute a validated fund transfer with transactional audit logging."""
    return {
        "success": True,
        "transaction_id": "tx_987123",
        "recipient": transfer.recipient_iban,
        "amount": transfer.amount_usd,
        "reference": transfer.reference_note,
    }

# 3. Equip directly onto an Agent or ChatInterface
agent = ui.Agent(
    name="TreasuryAgent",
    model="openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-chat",
    system_prompt="You are a treasury automation specialist with tool execution access.",
    tools=[get_account_balance, execute_funds_transfer],
)

app = ui.ChatInterface(agent=agent, title="Treasury Operations Swarm")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch()

FastAPI & REST Engine Zero Framework Lock-in

Native API Creation & Standalone Export

Define production-ready REST endpoints and real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming routes directly on your Pyvello application using @app.api.get, @app.api.post, or @app.api.stream. When exported, Pyvello generates a self-contained Python FastAPI backend in backend/main.py that runs natively with pure uvicorn main:app without requiring Pyvello to be installed.

Zero Backend Boilerplate

No separate FastAPI or Flask projects. Declare routes alongside your reactive UI and test them live via interactive Swagger UI at http://localhost:8000/swagger (with instant aliases at /api/swagger, /api/docs, and /docs/swagger).

SSE Real-Time Streaming

Use @app.api.stream with standard Python generators. Yielding dicts or strings automatically streams as text/event-stream.

Pydantic Schema Validation

Declare request body models with pydantic.BaseModel. Pyvello extracts schemas and preserves validation in both live dev and exported backends.

Standalone Deployment

Export generates a pure FastAPI backend + Vite React UI. Runs anywhere via Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Railway without Pyvello installed.

Where is Swagger UI? (/swagger, /api/docs, /docs/swagger)
Open Swagger UI openapi.json

In Pyvello, /docs is dedicated to the comprehensive framework documentation. To inspect and test your registered REST and streaming routes via OpenAPI 3.1 Swagger, navigate directly to /swagger or click the Swagger API Docs icon in the top header toolbar. Aliases at /api/swagger, /api/docs, and /docs/swagger redirect automatically.

1 Defining Endpoints & In-App Interactive UI

You can register routes using @app.api.<method> or shorthand @app.<method>. Inside with app:, build a rich reactive operations console with metrics, form controls, and live payload displays that invoke and demonstrate the endpoints directly:

api_studio_showcase.py 
import json
import pyvello as ui
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

app = ui.App(title="API Studio", palette="emerald")

class UserRecord(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str
    role: str = Field(default="developer")

# 1. Standard Synchronous GET with Query Parameter
@app.api.get("/api/v1/health")
def health(status_code: int = 200):
    return {"status": "operational", "code": status_code, "service": "api-studio"}

# 2. Asynchronous POST with Pydantic Body Validation
@app.api.post("/api/v1/users")
async def create_user(payload: UserRecord):
    return {"success": True, "created_user": payload.model_dump(), "timestamp": "2026-10-30T12:00:00Z"}

# 3. Dynamic Path Parameter Lookup
@app.api.get("/api/v1/users/{user_id}")
def get_user(user_id: str):
    return {"user_id": user_id, "found": True, "access_tier": "enterprise"}

# 4. Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) Streaming
@app.api.stream("/api/v1/ticks")
def stream_ticks(count: int = 5):
    for i in range(count):
        yield {"tick": i, "status": "active", "channel": "telemetry"}

# Rich In-App Operations Console & Live Interactive Tester
with app:
    # 1. Header with direct link to Swagger and System Badges
    with ui.row(class_name="w-full flex-row items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-border gap-4"):
        with ui.col(class_name="flex-1 min-w-0 gap-1"):
            ui.title("API Intelligence & Operations Studio", level=1)
            ui.text(
                "Interactive Python REST API gateway, real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE), and embedded client testing console."
            )
        with ui.row(class_name="shrink-0 flex-row items-center gap-2"):
            ui.badge("FastAPI Engine", variant="default")
            ui.badge("OpenAPI 3.1", variant="outline")
            ui.button("Open Swagger UI", href="/swagger", variant="outline", size="sm")

    # 2. Executive API Gateway Metrics
    col1, col2, col3, col4 = ui.columns(4)
    with col1:
        ui.metric("Active Endpoints", 4, delta="4 registered")
    with col2:
        ui.metric("Gateway Protocols", "REST + SSE", delta="Streaming enabled")
    with col3:
        ui.metric("Average Latency", "1.2 ms", delta="-0.3 ms vs target")
    with col4:
        ui.metric("OpenAPI Swagger", "/swagger", delta="Interactive UI")

    # 3. Interactive Route Showcase & In-App Testing Cards
    ui.title("Live Endpoint Explorer & UI Dispatcher", level=2)
    ui.text("Test API handlers directly from the Pyvello UI or query them externally with curl, fetch, or Swagger UI.")

    col_left, col_right = ui.columns(2)

    with col_left:
        # Card 1: Health Check (GET)
        with ui.card("1. GET /api/v1/health", description="Query gateway operational status with customizable response status code"):
            ui.callout("GET /api/v1/health?status_code=200", title="Endpoint Route", variant="info")
            health_code = ui.number_input("Target Status Code", value=200, min_value=200, max_value=599)
            health_output = ui.code('{\n  "status": "operational",\n  "code": 200,\n  "service": "api-studio"\n}', language="json")

            ui.callout("GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}", title="Path Parameter Route", variant="info")
            user_id_input = ui.text_input("User ID", value="usr_9042")

            def test_lookup():

    with col_right:

2 Standalone Export Architecture (Zero Framework Dependency)

When you click Export Fullstack Monorepo in the header or call ui.export_app_to_directory(app, output_dir), Pyvello decomposes your app into a clean production architecture:

backend/tools.py (Universal Tool Dispatcher)

Extracts all tools decorated with @ui.tool and all built-in production tools (query_knowledge_base, query_database, etc.). Emits mock datasets and the standalone dispatcher:

execute_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -> str
backend/main.py (Production Pyvello Server)

Generates a concise Pyvello application with CORS, health probes, AI chat completions, Pydantic schemas, and your custom routes mounted automatically. Exposes the ASGI instance api = app.get_fastapi_app():

uvicorn main:api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

3 Consuming Custom Endpoints from TypeScript / React

The exported frontend in frontend/src/api/client.ts includes typed helpers connecting the Vite React UI to your custom endpoints:

frontend/src/api/client.ts 
import * as api from './api/client';

// 1. Call custom GET endpoint
const health = await api.get<{ status: string }>('/api/v1/health');
console.log(health.status); // "operational"

// 2. Call custom POST endpoint with typed JSON body
const user = await api.post<{ success: boolean }>('/api/v1/users', {
  username: 'sarah_architect',
  email: 'sarah@enterprise.ai',
  role: 'Lead Architect',
});

// 3. Generic request helper
const data = await api.apiRequest('/api/v1/records/101', { method: 'GET' });

4 Standalone ASGI Engine & Container Deployment (Cloud Run, ECS, Fly.io)

In addition to interactive development with app.launch(), Pyvello exposes the underlying high-performance FastAPI/Starlette ASGI application directly via app.get_fastapi_app() or app.to_asgi(). This allows running behind production ASGI process supervisors like Uvicorn, Gunicorn, or Granian with multiple concurrency workers.

main.py (Direct ASGI Exposure) 
import pyvello as ui

app = ui.App(title="Enterprise API Gateway", palette="emerald")

@app.api.get("/api/v1/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "operational", "version": "1.0.0"}

with app:
    ui.title("Gateway Dashboard")
    ui.metric("Active Microservices", 12)

# Expose ASGI application instance for production ASGI servers
api = app.get_fastapi_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch(port=8000)
Dockerfile (Production Distroless/Slim) 
FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PORT=8000

# Install production dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy application source
COPY . .

EXPOSE 8000

# Launch with 4 ASGI async concurrency workers
CMD ["uvicorn", "main:api", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--workers", "4"]

A comprehensive fullstack application demonstrating every native API pattern and tool execution case in Pyvello: synchronous GET with query parameters, asynchronous POST with typed Pydantic payloads, dynamic path parameters, Server-Sent Events (SSE) live streaming, full CRUD (PUT & DELETE), custom tools (@ui.tool), built-in production tools (query_knowledge_base & query_database), interactive reactive UI, and standalone one-click monorepo export.

Cases 1-3: REST Endpoints

Sync GET with filters, async POST with Pydantic validation, and dynamic /orders/{id} path parameters.

Case 4: SSE Live Stream

Real-time telemetry streaming endpoint yielding JSON chunks over persistent Server-Sent Events.

Cases 5-7: Custom & Builtin Tools

Financial mortgage and risk tools created with @ui.tool alongside built-in RAG and SQL tools.

Cases 8-10: Export & UI

Interactive UI with live metrics and one-click export generating standalone Uvicorn FastAPI backend.

universal_api_suite_all_cases.py 
"""Universal Pyvello API & Agent Tool Suite — Complete All-Cases Implementation.

Demonstrates:
1. Custom Tools with @ui.tool (Sync & Async)
2. Built-in Pyvello Production Tools (RAG Vector Search & SQL Relational Database)
3. Pydantic Models & Request Validation
4. Synchronous GET with Query Parameters
5. Asynchronous POST with Pydantic JSON Body
6. Dynamic Path Parameter Lookup (/orders/{order_id})
7. CRUD Operations (PUT Update & DELETE)
8. Real-Time Server-Sent Events (SSE) Live Streaming (@app.api.stream)
9. Reactive UI with Metrics, Columns, and Autonomous Agent Chat
10. Standalone Zero-Dependency Backend Export (uvicorn main:app)
"""

import time
import asyncio
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import pyvello as ui

# Initialize Pyvello Application
app = ui.App(title="Universal API & Tool Studio", palette="emerald")

# ============================================================================
# CASE 1: CUSTOM AGENT TOOLS (SYNC & ASYNC WITH @ui.tool)
# ============================================================================

@ui.tool(description="Calculate mortgage amortization schedule and monthly payment.")
def calculate_mortgage(principal: float, annual_rate: float, years: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate loan payment given principal, rate percentage, and tenure in years."""
    r = (annual_rate / 100) / 12
    n = years * 12
    monthly = round(principal * (r * (1 + r)**n) / ((1 + r)**n - 1), 2)
    total_payment = round(monthly * n, 2)
    return {
        "principal": principal,
        "annual_rate_pct": annual_rate,
        "years": years,
        "monthly_payment": monthly,
        "total_interest": round(total_payment - principal, 2),
        "total_payment": total_payment,
    }

@ui.tool(description="Perform asynchronous financial risk assessment score lookup.")
async def evaluate_risk_score(company_ticker: str, sector: str = "Technology") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Asynchronously evaluate company risk metrics."""
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    return {
        "ticker": company_ticker.upper(),
        "sector": sector,
        "risk_score": 24,
        "grade": "A- (Low Risk)",
        "liquidity_ratio": 2.8,
        "debt_to_equity": 0.42,
    }

# ============================================================================
# CASE 2: CONNECTING AGENT WITH CUSTOM TOOLS + BUILT-IN PRODUCTION TOOLS
# ============================================================================

wealth_agent = ui.Agent(
    name="Wealth & Enterprise Specialist",
    system_prompt="You are a senior financial intelligence specialist. Use tools for all calculations and lookups.",
    model="gpt-4o",
    tools=[
        calculate_mortgage,        # Custom sync tool
        evaluate_risk_score,       # Custom async tool
        ui.query_knowledge_base,   # Builtin Pyvello RAG vector tool
        ui.query_database,         # Builtin Pyvello SQL database tool
    ],
)

# ============================================================================
# CASE 3: TYPED PYDANTIC REQUEST MODELS
# ============================================================================

class OrderItem(BaseModel):
    item_id: str
    quantity: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    unit_price: float

class CreateOrderRequest(BaseModel):
    customer_id: str
    customer_email: str
    items: List[OrderItem]
    notes: Optional[str] = None

# In-memory store for demonstration
ORDERS_DB: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

# ============================================================================
# CASE 4: SYNCHRONOUS GET WITH QUERY PARAMETERS
# ============================================================================

@app.api.get("/api/v1/health")
def api_health(detailed: bool = False):
    """Health check endpoint with optional detailed flag."""
    res = {"status": "healthy", "service": "pyvello-universal-api", "timestamp": time.time()}
    if detailed:
        res["tools_active"] = len(wealth_agent.tools)
        res["orders_count"] = len(ORDERS_DB)
    return res

# ============================================================================
# CASE 5: ASYNCHRONOUS POST WITH PYDANTIC BODY
# ============================================================================

@app.api.post("/api/v1/orders")
async def create_order(req: CreateOrderRequest):
    """Create a new customer order with validated Pydantic schema."""
    order_id = f"ORD-{len(ORDERS_DB) + 1001}"
    total_amount = sum(it.quantity * it.unit_price for it in req.items)
    order_record = {
        "order_id": order_id,
        "customer_id": req.customer_id,
        "customer_email": req.customer_email,
        "total_amount": round(total_amount, 2),
        "item_count": len(req.items),
        "status": "confirmed",
        "created_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }
    ORDERS_DB[order_id] = order_record
    return {"success": True, "order": order_record}

# ============================================================================
# CASE 6: DYNAMIC PATH PARAMETER LOOKUP
# ============================================================================

@app.api.get("/api/v1/orders/{order_id}")
def get_order_by_id(order_id: str):
    """Retrieve order by dynamic path parameter."""
    if order_id not in ORDERS_DB:
        return {"error": "Order not found", "requested_id": order_id}
    return {"success": True, "order": ORDERS_DB[order_id]}

# ============================================================================
# CASE 7: FULL CRUD OPERATIONS (PUT UPDATE & DELETE)
# ============================================================================

@app.api.put("/api/v1/orders/{order_id}")
def update_order_status(order_id: str, new_status: str = "shipped"):
    """Update existing order status via PUT."""
    if order_id not in ORDERS_DB:
        return {"error": "Order not found"}
    ORDERS_DB[order_id]["status"] = new_status
    return {"success": True, "order": ORDERS_DB[order_id]}

@app.api.delete("/api/v1/orders/{order_id}")
def delete_order(order_id: str):
    """Delete an order via DELETE."""
    if order_id in ORDERS_DB:
        del ORDERS_DB[order_id]
        return {"success": True, "deleted_id": order_id}
    return {"error": "Order not found"}

# ============================================================================
# CASE 8: REAL-TIME SERVER-SENT EVENTS (SSE) STREAMING
# ============================================================================

@app.api.stream("/api/v1/telemetry-stream")
def stream_telemetry(interval_count: int = 5):
    """Real-time SSE event stream yielding JSON telemetry chunks."""
    for step in range(interval_count):
        time.sleep(0.1)
        yield {
            "step": step + 1,
            "cpu_percent": round(18.5 + (step * 2.1), 1),
            "memory_mb": round(142.0 + (step * 5.4), 1),
            "active_connections": 12 + step,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        }

# ============================================================================
# CASE 9: REACTIVE PYVELLO UI
# ============================================================================

with app:
    ui.title("Universal API & Tool Studio")
    ui.text("Explore native backend routes and autonomous agent tool execution in a single script.")

    col1, col2, col3, col4 = ui.columns(4)
    with col1:
        ui.metric(label="API Routes", value="6 Endpoints", delta="REST + SSE")
    with col2:
        ui.metric(label="Connected Tools", value="4 Active", delta="Custom + Builtin")
    with col3:
        ui.metric(label="Pydantic Schemas", value="2 Models", delta="Validated")
    with col4:
        ui.metric(label="Backend Engine", value="Standalone FastAPI", delta="Zero Dependency")

    ui.divider()

    tab1, tab2 = ui.tabs(["Autonomous AI Chat & Tools", "Interactive API Client"])

    with tab1:
        ui.chat(agent=wealth_agent)

    with tab2:
        ui.text("Call custom backend endpoints natively:")
        ui.button("Call GET /health", on_click=lambda: ui.toast("Health OK"))
        ui.button("Trigger POST /orders", on_click=lambda: ui.toast("Order Created"))

# ============================================================================
# CASE 10: STANDALONE PRODUCTION EXPORT (ZERO PYVELLO DEPENDENCY)
# ============================================================================

def export_project():
    """Export fullstack Vite React + Python FastAPI backend to disk."""
    ui.export_app_to_directory(app, output_dir="./dist_fullstack")
    print("Exported production backend to ./dist_fullstack/backend")
    print("Run with: cd ./dist_fullstack/backend && uvicorn main:app --reload")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch()
